stories.title: Follow live: Packers tie score vs. Rams as Kamren Kinchens tossed for big hit on Christian Watson
Steelers cut Rodgers after QB rips McCarthy in scorched-earth interview
stories.summary: The Steelers have waived Aaron Rodgers after the quarterback said Wednesday on "The Pat McAfee Show" that coach Mike McCarthy has been sleeping through team meetings.

stories.title: Sources corroborate Rodgers' shocking McCarthy allegations: 'It's all true'
stories.summary: NFL sources have corroborated Aaron Rodgers' account of Mike McCarthy to ESPN reporters, confirming the star QB's allegations about the Steelers coach.

stories.title: Sources: McCarthy has Steelers' full support after Rodgers' bombshell interview
stories.summary: Mike McCarthy has the full support of the Steelers organization and will remain the team's coach after Aaron Rodgers' allegations, sources told NFL Network and ESPN.

stories.title: Aiyuk signing with Commanders, reunites with college QB Daniels
stories.summary: Wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk is signing with the Commanders on their practice squad, the team announced.
